prompt:
Create a 15-second high-quality 3D animated comedy sequence in a bright, colorful countryside meadow.

A huge, chubby orange-and-black tiger with expressive cartoon facial features is playfully chasing a small energetic rooster through a sunny green field. The tiger holds an oversized pink fly swatter in one paw and tries repeatedly to catch the rooster.

0–2 seconds: Start with a low-angle wide shot of the beautiful meadow under a vivid blue sky with soft white clouds, colorful wildflowers, and distant trees. The tiger runs toward the camera while the rooster desperately runs away in front of him.

2–4 seconds: Quickly move into a dynamic low-angle shot as the tiger swings the oversized pink fly swatter toward the rooster. The rooster narrowly escapes, jumping sideways.

4–7 seconds: Show the tiger making an exaggerated leap through the air, paws stretched forward, while the rooster jumps and flies just out of reach. Use energetic camera movement and slight motion blur for comedic impact.

7–10 seconds: Cut between close and medium shots as the tiger repeatedly swings the pink fly swatter across the grass. The rooster dodges every attempt with exaggerated but believable cartoon movement.

10–12 seconds: The tiger becomes increasingly frustrated and charges forward at full speed. The rooster suddenly changes direction, causing the tiger to lose balance.

12–15 seconds: Final wide cinematic shot: the tiger tumbles dramatically onto the soft grass and lies sprawled out, exhausted and stunned, while the rooster calmly stands nearby looking at him. The pink fly swatter lands in the grass nearby. End on the funny contrast between the exhausted tiger and the victorious rooster.

Visual style: polished high-end 3D animation, colorful cinematic cartoon aesthetic, detailed fur and feathers, expressive faces, smooth character animation, exaggerated physical comedy, realistic shadows, bright summer sunlight, vibrant green grass, colorful flowers, blue sky, cinematic depth of field, dynamic low-angle camera shots, smooth tracking, fast action cuts, subtle motion blur, believable physics, playful family-friendly humor.

Character consistency: keep the same large chubby tiger, same orange-and-black stripes, same rooster, same pink fly swatter, and same meadow throughout the entire video.

Negative prompt: photorealism, live action, horror, dark lighting, distorted characters, deformed faces, extra limbs, malformed paws, duplicated animals, unnatural anatomy, flickering, character changes, text, subtitles, logos, watermark

2–4 秒：迅速切入动感的低角度镜头，老虎挥舞着超大的粉色苍蝇拍击向公鸡。公鸡险之又险地向侧面跳开逃脱。

4–7 秒：展示老虎夸张地跃向空中，爪子向前伸展，而公鸡则跳起飞扑，刚好逃出抓捕范围。运用充满活力的镜头运动和轻微的动态模糊以增强喜剧效果。

10–12 segundos: El tigre se frustra cada vez más y arremete hacia adelante a toda velocidad. El gallo cambia repentinamente de dirección, haciendo que el tigre pierda el equilibrio.

12–15 segundos: Plano general cinematográfico final: el tigre tropieza dramáticamente sobre la hierba suave y queda tendido, exhausto y aturdido, mientras el gallo se queda tranquilamente cerca mirándolo.
